2226-2397-3634.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-3634.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost.
When Venser enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2486-2921-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-2921-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.

1170-3581-5131-5315--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3581-5131-5315--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}.
Kykar and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5330-7692--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5330-7692--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Shuri.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4742-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-4742-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4742-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

4681-5170-6772-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2292-4766-7361.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more Spirits.
2292-4766-7361.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kodama.
When Kodama dies, its soulshift ability and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Kodama from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4050-5220-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it triggers. Choose its first mode targeting yourself.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2292-6132.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4862-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-4862-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Omnath trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

821-2173-5220-5332.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

4067-4182-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six permanent cards in your graveyard.
4067-4182-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping The Core.
Repeat.

869-1306-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1170-4124-5921-5954-6763.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

413-856-4321-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
413-856-4321-5632.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token, Clue token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

478-4249-4331.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least six.
478-4249-4331.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Nykthos.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Candelabra of Tawnos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1912-2060-3062-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-3062-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

440-1339-2428-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2428-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God and Horizon Chimera trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Horizon Chimera trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1238-2351-2438-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

2079-4499-4747.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

1416-2178-4481.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1416-2178-4481.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

275-1984-3454-4406.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{W} the first turn, with {10}{R}{R}{W}{W} available each extra turn
275-1984-3454-4406.notablePrerequisites: Sunforger attached to a creature you control.
275-1984-3454-4406.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Chance for Glory and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chance for Glory, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Chance for Glory on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Angel's Grace and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Angel's Grace, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Angel's Grace on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Chance for Glory triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 4.

628-2438-3723.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

126-2697-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
126-2697-3976.description:
Cast Last Chance by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Last Chance and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creature that has Last Chance noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Last Chance without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Obeka by tapping it, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Last Chance trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

1558-1692-3263-4075.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Master of Waves.
Your devotion to blue is at least four.
1558-1692-3263-4075.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Master of Waves with haste.
The Master of Waves token enters the battlefield, creating a number of 1/0 Elemental creature tokens equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creature tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

719-1303-2743-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Biovisionary.
Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Repeat steps 1-2 two additional times.
At the beginning of your end step, Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.
